name: sun_blessed_healer_kicked_returns_the_chosen_card
notes: M4 mapper. Printed: 'Kicker {1}{W}. When this creature enters, if it was kicked, return target nonland permanent card with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.' Seat 0 casts Sun-Blessed Healer kicked ({1}{W} + {1}{W}) and returns the chosen Grave Relic (an artifact card, mana value 2) to the battlefield under its control; the Grave Charm stays in the graveyard.
